identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route Shepherd conversation replies through its configured provider

values.goal: Make fresh resident Shepherd conversation turns use the Shepherd's configured model provider instead of a hardcoded acknowledgement.
values.required_outcome: A Shepherd turn invokes its configured provider and returns generated content in the existing reply envelope; provider failure is explicit and never becomes synthetic success.
authority_boundary: Issue #661 owns only Shepherd reply execution
Issue #640 supplies configured model-backed Shepherd state
operator_constraints: Never write tracked files on main
Do not restart or mutate the live Runtime
Do not widen into agent-to-agent initiation
